title: Craftable Bedrock Recipe
body:
# Craftable Bedrock

**Craftable Bedrock: Bend Reality**

Break the Rules. You weren’t supposed to touch it. You weren’t supposed to move it. And you definitely weren’t supposed to craft it. But this datapack says: why not?

Now you can forge the unbreakable — the very foundation of Minecraft itself — and wield it like a god of creation. Build prisons no one escapes. Fortresses no one breaks. Or just flex with blocks that laugh in the face of TNT.

Note: “Bedrock Recipe” is a custom recipe added by the datapack. Use responsibly… or don’t.If you are intrested in more Datapacks check out the links at the end of the descrption.

**🧠 Why It’s Better **
Because chaos is fun. Whether you're designing troll-proof traps, building admin-level bunkers, or just want to rewrite the laws of physics, this pack gives you the power Mojang never meant to share.

**📦 How to Use:**

1. Download the .zip
   
2. Drop it into your world’s datapacks/ folder
   
3. Type /reload in-game
   
4. Craft your Bedrock and become the architect of the impossible
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
